title: Mini Countryman AC and controls
summary: Feedback on the Mini Countryman in this sample centers on affection for the previous model’s specification and controls, with a specific complaint about AC configurability and several mentions that are too vague to classify clearly.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the Countryman overall and prefers its older-style controls and specification to alternatives.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on dissatisfaction with AC controls, especially the inability to un-sync the climate settings.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions reference stronger AC, missing prior Mini features, or nostalgia for older Minis, but they do not provide enough context for a clear sentiment classification.

limitations: Most sampled mentions are undetermined, so the clearly expressed sentiment is limited.
Several fragments compare the Mini Countryman with previous Minis or other vehicles rather than describing the current vehicle directly.
The topic mixes AC comments with broader nostalgia and specification comparisons, so it is not fully coherent as a single aspect.
